name: record_hypothesis
arguments: {"statement": "The Arg226Cys substitution sits in a beta strand (residues 219-226) of the fibronectin type-III domain of IL2RG. Losing the charged, buried-side-chain Arg and adding a smaller Cys destabilises that strand and the domain fold, so less correctly folded receptor reaches the surface.", "mechanism_class": "stability_folding", "supports": ["E4", "E6", "E7", "E10", "E12", "E14", "E15", "E5"], "would_refute": "Computed stability change for R226C versus wild type (for example FoldX or Rosetta \u0394\u0394G on the AlphaFold DB model or a PDB template) is near zero or stabilising, and molecular dynamics of R226C versus wild type over matched replicates show no difference in backbone RMSD or strand H-bond persistence around residue 226.", "starting_rank": 1, "rank_rationale": "Ranked first because E7 is the only retrieved structural observation of this exact variant (MD instability of the R226C model versus stable wild type), and it sits in a conserved beta strand of the FN-III domain (E4, E6, E12) with high pathogenicity scores (E10, E15). Still weak: E7 comes from one homology model with no experimental stability or expression data (G1), and no structure with residue 226 mutated exists (G5), so the stability reading has not been tested independently."}

arguments: {"statement": "Residue 226 lies at or near the IL-2 / IL-21 / IL-4R-binding surface of IL2RG. Arg226Cys removes the Arg side chain's hydrogen bonds and charge contacts with the cytokine, so the receptor binds IL-2 and IL-21 more weakly and signalling through the common gamma chain is lost.", "mechanism_class": "protein_interaction", "supports": ["E9", "E11", "E17", "E18", "E20", "E2", "E1"], "would_refute": "Cytokine-bound experimental structures (9E2T, 5M5E) place residue 226 with no atom within about 4.5 \u00c5 of IL-2, IL-21 or IL-4R partner chains, and docking or free-energy calculations of R226C versus wild type show no change in interface contacts or binding energy beyond the spread between replicate runs.", "starting_rank": 2, "rank_rationale": "Ranked second because the interface evidence is also about this exact variant (E9 fewer hydrogen bonds and weaker IL-21 binding; E11 MM/PBSA gap) and two cytokine-bound structures observe residue 226 (E17, E18).
